outlets.name: Disney Tourist Blog (Tom Bricker)
outlets.credible: Long-running (since 2011) independent Disney-parks blog by Tom Bricker, one of the most-read Disney trip-planning sites; detailed first-hand restaurant reviews.

outlets.name: WDW News Today
outlets.credible: Daily Disney/Universal parks news site and YouTube channel (WDWNT, 500k+ subscribers) with first-hand, dated photo reports of openings, closures and full-menu reviews.
